title: The Funfest Missions: res/funfest/missions.json
description: Files 0 and 1 of ARCID_FMISSION_DATA (a/2/8/9): each mission's FestMissionHeader and FestMissionParams (field/fest_mission_data.h), FEST_MISSION_COUNT of them in order, which FestMission_Load copies into the mission's FestMissionInfo (system/fest_mission.h). tools/data/funfest_mission_data.py packs them.

kind.description: FestMissionHeader.kind: what the target is by data_ov027_021711c0 (1 a species, 4 and 5 an item), and the field's missions MISSION_FLAGS (2), MISSION_HOLLOW, MISSION_SPARKLE and MISSION_PEOPLE (5) of field/fest_mission_data.h

message.description: The mission's goal, a message of res/text/system/funfest_missions.txt by ID, with the target and the count as its words (FestMission_GetMessage)

result_message.description: The message of its result, of the same file (FestMission_GetResultMessage)

target.description: The species or item the mission is about (FestMissionInfo.target), a SPECIES_* constant for kind 1; for a people mission the set of people (sPeopleSets in fest_mission_people.c)

target_kind.description: What the target counts, which picks the goal's message, its "Target:" line and its icon (FestMissionInfo.targetKind)

variant.description: FestMissionInfo.unk0_20: a people mission's variant of its set of people (FesMissionPeople_GetPerson), and for target 8 its species list, file 2 plus it

reward_item.description: The item of the mission's reward (FestMissionInfo.unk4_0)

required_flag.description: An event flag that must be set to join the mission, or 0 (FestMissionInfo.requiredFlag)

extra_seconds_index.description: Which of FestMission_ExtraSeconds a gain of time counts (FestMissionInfo.extraSecondsIndex)

count.description: The total score the mission wants (FestMissionInfo.count)

reward_item_count.description: How many of the reward item the mission gives (FestMissionParams.levels[].rewardItemCount)

ends_at_target.description: Whether the mission ends once its target is reached (FestMissionParams.endsAtTarget)

second_item_count.description: How many of the second item the mission gives (FestMissionParams.rewardItem2Count)

unlock_flag.description: An event flag that the mission select needs set to list the mission, or 0 (FestMissionParams.unlockFlag)

stage_patterns.description: Three bits by level, the pattern of the mission's stage (FestMissionParams.stagePatterns)

version.description: Where the mission is available (FestMissionHeader.version): 0 both versions, 1 White 2, 2 Black 2, 4 to 7 after a download

clear_flag.description: An event flag set when the mission is first cleared, or 0 (FestMissionHeader.clearFlag)
